sources.energy_cost_tier: NIHONBASHI DATA_MAIN.xlsx (Revitalization Cost / Property Value Estimates / Building Age & Tier)

Office.basis: Office Grade B Tokyo 23-ku: ¥7,338/m²/mo (CBRE Q1 2026) × 12 ÷ 3.15% office cap rate (CBRE Q1 2026)

Residence & Commercial Mixed.basis: Placeholder: average of Office and Apartment rates, pending per-building floor-use mix from occupancy data

Apartment.basis: Residential, SUUMO Nihonbashi: ¥5,469/m²/mo × 12 ÷ 3.60% avg residential cap rate (CBRE Q1 2026)

Public.basis: Placeholder for renovation-cost estimation: public buildings aren't market-traded, so this links to the Office rate (civic/institutional buildings are typically built to office-grade specs). Replace once building-specific data is available.

Reconstruct.scope: Demolish & full rebuild; structure, envelope, services, finishes, external works

Renovate.scope: Envelope upgrade (R-value, U-value, WWR), HVAC replacement, programmatic/FAR changes

Maintenance.scope: Minor envelope, lighting retrofit, HVAC tuning, optional rooftop PV

carbon_grid_factors.note: No Nihonbashi-specific grid factor in workbook; values below derived from the REopt run (TS_ND_1... results.json), a US (Cambium SERTP / Southeast) proxy.

assumptions.cost_escalation_note: Cost escalation: 2015-base construction indices (kentiku files) sit ~1.42–1.45x in 2026; the ¥302,000/m² figure is treated
